prisma/schema.prisma.content:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  CUSTOMER
  ADMIN
}

enum Locale {
  uk
  ru
  en
}

enum Currency {
  USD
  UAH
  USDT
}

enum ProductKind {
  UNIQUE
  BULK
  SERVICE
}

enum FulfillmentMode {
  INVENTORY
  PROVIDER
  MANUAL
}

enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  FULFILLING
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
  REFUNDED
  NEEDS_REVIEW
}

enum Channel {
  WEB
  TMA
  BOT
}

enum InventoryStatus {
  AVAILABLE
  RESERVED
  SOLD
  DISABLED
}

enum FulfillmentStatus {
  PENDING
  PROCESSING
  DELIVERED
  FAILED
}

enum TransactionKind {
  DEPOSIT
  PURCHASE
  REFUND
  ADJUSTMENT
}

enum TransactionStatus {
  PENDING
  POSTED
  FAILED
}

enum PaymentProvider {
  CRYPTO_PAY
  MONO
  FONDY
  STRIPE
  TELEGRAM_STARS
}

model User {
  id              String          @id @default(cuid())
  telegramId      BigInt?         @unique
  email           String?         @unique
  emailVerifiedAt DateTime?
  passwordHash    String?
  onboardingStartedAt DateTime?
  onboardingCompletedAt DateTime?
  lastActiveAt DateTime @default(now())
  avatarBytes Bytes?
  avatarUpdatedAt DateTime?
  displayName     String?
  locale          Locale          @default(uk)
  role            Role            @default(CUSTOMER)
  sessions        UserSession[]
  payments        PaymentIntent[]
  adminSessions   AdminSession[]
  adminAuditLogs  AdminAuditLog[]
  wallets         Wallet[]
  orders          Order[]         @relation("Buyer")
  assignedItems   OrderItem[]     @relation("Assignee")
  transactions    Transaction[]
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime        @updatedAt

  @@index([role, lastActiveAt])
}

model Wallet {
  id           String        @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  currency     Currency
  balance      String       @default("0")
  version      Int           @default(0)
  transactions Transaction[]

  @@unique([userId, currency])
}

model Category {
  id           String                @id @default(cuid())
  slug         String                @unique
  parentId     String?
  parent       Category?             @relation("Tree", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  children     Category[]            @relation("Tree")
  translations CategoryTranslation[]
  products     Product[]
  position     Int                   @default(0)
  active       Boolean               @default(true)
}

model CategoryTranslation {
  categoryId  String
  locale      Locale
  title       String
  description String?
  category    Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([categoryId, locale])
}

model Product {
  id                String               @id @default(cuid())
  slug              String               @unique
  categoryId        String
  category          Category             @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  brandAssetId      String?
  brandAsset        BrandAsset?          @relation(fields: [brandAssetId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  version           Int                  @default(0)
  verificationGroup String?
  translations      ProductTranslation[]
  kind              ProductKind
  fulfillmentMode   FulfillmentMode
  price             String              
  currency          Currency             @default(USD)
  imageUrl          String?
  active            Boolean              @default(false)
  provider          String?
  providerProductId String?
  // Public filter attributes only; never credentials or API tokens.
  attributes        Json?
  minQuantity       Int                  @default(1)
  maxQuantity       Int                  @default(1)
  inventory         InventoryItem[]
  orderItems        OrderItem[]
  createdAt         DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime             @updatedAt

  @@unique([provider, providerProductId])
  @@index([categoryId, active, price])
}

model ProductTranslation {
  productId   String
  locale      Locale
  title       String
  description String
  product     Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([productId, locale])
}

model InventoryItem {
  id               String          @id @default(cuid())
  productId        String
  product          Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  status           InventoryStatus @default(AVAILABLE)
  // Encrypt server-side using a key outside the DB; never expose in catalog DTOs.
  encryptedPayload String
  orderItemId      String?
  orderItem        OrderItem?      @relation(fields: [orderItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  reservedUntil    DateTime?
  soldAt           DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime        @default(now())

  @@index([productId, status])
  @@index([status, reservedUntil])
}

model Order {
  id             String        @id @default(cuid())
  userId         String
  user           User          @relation("Buyer", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  status         OrderStatus   @default(PENDING)
  channel        Channel
  currency       Currency
  total          String       
  // Client retries reuse this key, scoped to the authenticated buyer.
  idempotencyKey String
  payments       PaymentIntent[]
  requestHash    String?
  items          OrderItem[]
  transactions   Transaction[]
  paidAt         DateTime?
  completedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime      @updatedAt

  @@unique([userId, idempotencyKey])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

model OrderItem {
  id                String            @id @default(cuid())
  orderId           String
  order             Order             @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  productId         String
  product           Product           @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  requestData       Json?
  fulfillmentJob    FulfillmentJob?
  titleSnapshot     String
  quantity          Int
  lineTotal         String           @default("0")
  unitPrice         String           
  fulfillmentMode   FulfillmentMode
  fulfillmentStatus FulfillmentStatus @default(PENDING)
  provider          String?
  providerOrderId   String?
  assignedToId      String?
  assignedTo        User?             @relation("Assignee", fields: [assignedToId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  encryptedDelivery String?
  deliveredAt       DateTime?
  inventory         InventoryItem[]
  smmJob            SmmJob?

  @@unique([provider, providerOrderId])
  @@index([fulfillmentMode, fulfillmentStatus])
}

model Transaction {
  id                String            @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  user              User              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  walletId          String
  wallet            Wallet            @relation(fields: [walletId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  orderId           String?
  order             Order?            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  kind              TransactionKind
  status            TransactionStatus @default(PENDING)
  // Signed delta: deposits/refunds > 0, purchases < 0. Currency = wallet.currency.
  amount            String           
  idempotencyKey    String            @unique
  provider          PaymentProvider?
  providerReference String?
  postedAt          DateTime?
  createdAt         DateTime          @default(now())

  @@unique([provider, providerReference])
  @@index([walletId, createdAt])
}

enum SmmJobState {
  QUEUED
  PREPARING
  SENDING
  RUNNING
  COMPLETED
  PARTIAL
  CANCELED
  FAILED
  UNKNOWN
}

model SmmJob {
  id                  String      @id @default(cuid())
  orderItemId         String      @unique
  orderItem           OrderItem   @relation(fields: [orderItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  serviceKey          String
  providerServiceId   String
  providerFingerprint String
  targetLink          String
  quantity            Int
  maxCharge           String     
  providerCurrency    String
  providerOrderId     String?     @unique
  state               SmmJobState @default(QUEUED)
  attempts            Int         @default(0)
  runAt               DateTime    @default(now())
  leaseUntil          DateTime?
  remaining           Int?
  lastErrorCode       String?
  createdAt           DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime    @updatedAt

  @@index([state, runAt])
}

model BrandAsset {
  id        String    @id
  name      String
  imageUrl  String
  pngBytes  Bytes?
  color     String    @default("#a78bfa")
  group     String    @default("exchange")
  sourceUrl String?
  products  Product[]
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
}

model AdminSession {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  tokenHash String   @unique
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model AdminLoginBucket {
  id        String   @id
  attempts  Int      @default(0)
  expiresAt DateTime

  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model AdminAuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  actorId   String
  actor     User     @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  action    String
  entityId  String
  before    Json?
  after     Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([entityId, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model UserSession {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  tokenHash String @unique
  userId String
  user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id], onDelete:Cascade)
  channel Channel @default(WEB)
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

enum PaymentState {
  CREATING
  PENDING
  PAID
  FAILED
  UNKNOWN
  REFUNDING
  REFUNDED
}
model PaymentIntent {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String
  user User @relation(fields:[userId], references:[id], onDelete:Restrict)
  orderId String?
  order Order? @relation(fields:[orderId], references:[id], onDelete:Restrict)
  provider PaymentProvider
  purpose String
  state PaymentState @default(CREATING)
  walletCurrency Currency
  creditAmount String 
  expectedAmount String
  expectedCurrency String
  providerReference String?
  chargeId String? @unique
  preCheckoutId String? @unique
  paymentUrl String?
  idempotencyKey String
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  @@unique([userId,idempotencyKey])
  @@unique([provider,providerReference])
  @@index([state,expiresAt])
}
model FulfillmentJob {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  orderItemId String @unique
  orderItem OrderItem @relation(fields:[orderItemId], references:[id], onDelete:Restrict)
  state SmmJobState @default(QUEUED)
  attempts Int @default(0)
  runAt DateTime @default(now())
  leaseUntil DateTime?
  lastErrorCode String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  @@index([state,runAt])
}
model MarketplaceReservation {
  itemId String @id
  orderItemId String @unique
  expiresAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}
model Notification {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  telegramId BigInt
  orderId String?
  kind String
  text String
  deduplicationKey String @unique
  deliveredAt DateTime?
  leaseUntil DateTime?
  attempts Int @default(0)
  lastErrorCode String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  @@index([deliveredAt,createdAt])
}

model CartHandoff {
  tokenHash String @id
  entries Json
  locale Locale
  claimedById String?
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model ServiceHeartbeat {
  id            String   @id
  lastSeenAt    DateTime @default(now())
  lastSuccessAt DateTime?
  lastErrorCode String?
}

model NftWalletProof {
  userId String @id
  payload String @unique
  address String?
  expiresAt DateTime
  @@index([expiresAt])
}
model NftPurchase {
  id String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String
  nftAddress String
  walletAddress String
  previousOwner String
  name String
  baseNano String
  feeNano String
  transaction Json
  state String @default("PREPARED")
  expiresAt DateTime
  deliveredAt DateTime?
  feeTxHash String? @unique
  deliveryTxHash String? @unique
  feePendingUntil DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  @@index([userId,createdAt])
}
